vetSays.line: 🛡️ Lauren, the man in his 60s, with a buzz cut, Bessie, Pilar and Aroha met them at the door — 5 put down. Lauren, the man in his 60s, with a buzz cut, Bessie, Pilar, Aroha are hurt.
🛡️ Lauren, Bessie, Pilar and Jovan met them at the door — 4 put down. Lauren, Bessie, Pilar, Jovan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jovan just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dale just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lauren, Tikhon, Henry, Farid and Jesse met them at the door — 5 put down. Lauren, Tikhon, Henry, Farid, Jesse are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aroha just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Bessie, Aroha, Farid and Jesse met them at the door — 4 put down. Bessie, Aroha, Farid, Jesse are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bessie just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Henry, Farid, Ella, Naran and David met them at the door — 5 put down. Henry, Farid, Ella, Naran, David are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Choir Toad (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Choir Toad falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Choir Toad!

regDeaths.name: stripes flowing where no wind blows
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
the absence of sound, shaped like wings

something huge, rooting in the underbrush
